dataset.label_method: A window is attack=1 if ANY officially labelled line falls in it, and on both scenarios that label is dominated by one continuously-running DNS exfiltration tool (1,026 of 1,031 attack windows on russellmitchell and 663 of 667 on santos carry only dnsteal-family steps, docs/part26-ait-loader.md sections 0 and 12), so the task is 'was the exfiltration tool running in this window', NOT 'detect an APT' and not 'detect a multi-step intrusion'.

directions.label: A: train russellmitchell -> test santos

dependence.label: different sensors, naturally dependent
dependence.caveat: These views sit on DIFFERENT physical sensors. The dependence is a property of the scenario, not of shared hardware. This is NOT a same-sensor result and must not be read as one.

honest_duplication.reason: sensor_groups() returns {'network': [4]} -- one member, suricata -- so no within-group PAIR exists and the strict same-sensor comparison has no value to report. There is no packet-capture view yet (docs/part27-ait-datacard.md section 9, limitation 9). Nothing was substituted under this name; see natural_dependence for a DIFFERENT and separately labelled quantity.
